name: Akadake, Yatsugatake
why: Up the red volcanic pyramid of Akadake, the highest of the Yatsugatake, by chains and ladders from mountain huts in a moss forest.
book: Bus from Chino station to Minotoguchi. Huts at Akadake-kosen and Gyoja-goya (book for a night).
dangers: Chains and ladders on steep rock.
Ice and snow from November to May.

points.name: Minotoguchi
points.note: The bus stop at the end of the road.

points.name: Akadake-kosen
points.note: A hut in the forest under the red peak.
